sourcePolicy: one 3x2 true-frame source per sequence; retain sources; no router or automatic POST retry
directionPolicy: Shared nonbody kit; projectile follows aim. Frontal fixed-view spirit only, not eight directional creature views.

sequences.subject: Isolated horizontal ground slit mark, thin ink tear edged with ancient ivory light and two bronze splinters. Flat foreshortened ground effect, no sword object. Six phases: hairline crack; tiny split; jagged growing cut; defined split; trembling fragments; bright poised slit. Fixed mark at 50% cell width and 64% cell height.

Isolated wrist-scale spiritual sword-energy pulse without a wrist or hand. Curved ink vortex around an ivory needle, bronze sparks, gathering qi. Six phases: tiny seed; two wisps curl; condensed dark ring; ivory core forms; concentrated asymmetric spirals; compressed sword-tip flare. Fixed emitter at exact cell center.

Isolated east-facing lance of sword qi: narrow horizontal ivory blade of light inside jagged ink, smoky black rear stream and restrained bronze flecks. No physical sword hilt. Six distinct flight phases change ink contour, splitting fins and core flare. Every whole projectile centered at cell center facing right. No travel path or translation across cells.

Isolated confirmed ground contact burst: chipped ink splash pierced by ivory white impact core, tiny bronze shards. Six phases: white spark; narrow fracture; full asymmetric white-core ink burst; breaking chips; drooping ink fragments; tiny fading flecks. No enemy, blood, rubble or terrain. Fixed contact point at 50% cell width and 74% cell height.

Isolated dissipation of broken sword-qi threads: horizontal black ink wisps and pale ivory slivers from a vanished lance. Six phases: fraying strands; separated curled threads; shorter broken ribbons; sparse chips; two delicate wisps; final small flecks. Every phase has visible pixels, fixed emitter at cell center. No weapon or trail outside cell.

ONE isolated dormant sword stake of dark ink and old bronze, diamond pommel, slender straight silhouette, ghostly ivory groove. Ground warning cue, not entire array. Six phases: faint charcoal outline; visible dark stake; pale groove; tiny base crack; pulsing ivory seam; poised stake with small ink wisps. Fixed ground point at 50% cell width and 82% cell height.

ONE isolated towering spiritual sword stake emerging from an ink fissure, aged bronze outline and ivory blade. Six phases: tip breaks a tiny fissure; half-height stake rises; full stake extends; ivory core erupts; bright edge with black streaming qi; stable giant stake with settling ink. Same ground point at 50% cell width and 84% cell height. No rock, terrain or whole array.

ONE enormous ethereal ancient cultivator avatar UPPER TORSO, frontal neutral fixed view: spectral ink deity, abstract stern shadow face and ivory eyes, long black ink hair, old ivory/charcoal ritual robes, raised right palm projecting sword intent, left sleeve dissolving. No legs, no corporeal player or player face. Six phases: foggy torso manifests; face/sleeve emerge; broad sleeve flares; palm thrusts slightly; hair/robe sweep differently; hair curls and posture settles. Fixed dissolved torso base at 50% cell width and 84% cell height. Full hair, hand, sleeve and particles safely inside every cell. The spirit will appear behind an unseen 80px player and feel several times taller.

ONE isolated ground impact: vertical ivory-white slash from a jagged oval ink fissure, angular bronze chips and dark qi fountain. Six phases: tiny core flash; tall white spike; full chipped ink eruption; split spike and falling shards; crumbling fountain; fading fragments. No enemy, body, blood or physical terrain. Fixed contact point at 50% cell width and 80% cell height.

ONE isolated spiritual sword stake collapsing into ink, old bronze diamond pommel and slender ivory groove matching deploy. Six phases: standing stake fractures; upper blade dissolves into angular fragments; broken middle sinks; short lower blade disappears; swirling ink ring with bronze slivers; final ink flecks. Fixed ground point at 50% cell width and 84% cell height. No terrain or whole array.
